  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Data Entry / Store Officer",
  "description": "Coleman Technical Industries Limited, the manufacturer of the reputable Coleman Wires and Cables, is Sub-the Saharan Africa&rsquo;s largest cable manufacturer, renowned for quality, reliability, and innovation. From its ultra-modern manufacturing facilities in Arepo and Sagamu, including its recently commissioned state-of-the-art plant, producing the best fibre-optic cables with FRP in Africa, the company remains committed to industrial excellence, safety, and national development.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Data Entry / Store Officer
Job Location: Arepo, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry/Store Officer to support accurate data entry, inventory documentation, stock control, and day-to-day store operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate inventory and transaction records, updating the ERP system, monitoring stock movements, and ensuring that all store-related documentation is properly captured and maintained.


Key Responsibilities
Data Entry &amp; Record Management:


	Accurately enter and update inventory, stock movement, receipts, issues, transfers, and other store-related transactions into the ERP system.
	Maintain accurate and up-to-date electronic and physical records of inventory transactions.
	Verify data and documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
	Identify and report discrepancies or errors in inventory records.
	Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly store and inventory reports.
	File and retrieve store documents, including Goods Received Notes (GRNs), Material Requisition Forms, Store Issue Vouchers, delivery notes, and other relevant documents.


Inventory &amp; Stock Control:


	Maintain accurate records of stock levels, material usage, and product movements.
	Conduct regular stock counts and reconcile physical stock with ERP records.
	Monitor stock levels and promptly report shortages, excesses, damages, and discrepancies.
	Ensure all received and issued materials are properly documented and recorded.
	Support inventory audits and stock reconciliation exercises.


Store Operations:


	Assist in the receipt, identification, storage, and issuance of raw materials, consumables, tools, and finished products.
	Ensure materials are properly arranged, labeled, and stored for easy identification and retrieval.
	Ensure appropriate inventory rotation methods, including FIFO and LIFO where applicable.
	Assist in loading and offloading activities while ensuring proper documentation.


ERP &amp; Reporting:


	Ensure timely and accurate posting of store transactions into the ERP system.
	Generate stock movement, inventory status, material usage, and other required reports.
	Cross-check physical stock records against system-generated reports.
	Support the preparation of management reports relating to inventory and store activities.


Compliance &amp; Safety:


	Ensure proper documentation and authorization of all store transactions.
	Maintain a clean, organized, and secure store environment.
	Comply with company policies, inventory procedures, and HSE requirements.
	Ensure proper handling and storage of materials to prevent damage or loss.


Coordination &amp; Communication:


	Work closely with Production, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, and other relevant departments.
	Communicate stock discrepancies, shortages, and other inventory issues promptly.
	Assist in ensuring timely availability of materials required for production and other operations.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree or HND in Management, Social Sciences, Accounting, Business Administration, Computer Science, Statistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
	3&ndash;5 years of relevant experience in data entry, inventory management, store operations, warehouse administration, or a related role, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
	Proven experience using ERP software for data entry and inventory management.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
	Experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, Oracle ERP, or similar systems is an advantage.
	Professional certification in Data Management, Inventory Management, Warehouse Operations, or related fields is an added advantage.
	Applicants must be between 25 and 35 years of age.


Technical Skills:


	Excellent data entry and record-keeping skills.
	Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
	Ability to work with ERP and inventory management systems.
	Good knowledge of inventory control and stock reconciliation.
	Strong numerical and analytical skills.
	High typing accuracy and attention to detail.


Location Requirement:


	
	Applicants must reside in Arepo, Ogun State, or within a reasonable commuting distance from Arepo.
	


Why Join Us?


	Opportunity to work with West Africa&rsquo;s leading cable manufacturer.
	Career growth and professional development opportunities.
	Structured and technology-driven work environment.
	Competitive salary and benefits package.
	Opportunity to build experience in data management, inventory control, and manufacturing operations.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume to: careers@colemancables.com using &ldquo;Data Entry/Store Officer&rdquo; as the subject of the email.

title: Job Openings at Joes & Eves Limited
content:
Joes & Eves is increasingly recognised as a leading business management and solutions provider for MSMEs in Nigeria. We are renowned for our innovative and sought-after solutions to corporate challenges, offering 21st-century strategies and customer-centric values.

Our prompt, custom-designed solutions have earned us a strong reputation. We are known for our diverse products and services, including auditing, training institutes, consulting, project management, product design, and libraries.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Security Officer

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Accommodation: Not provided
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



Requirements


	2–4 years of relevant security experience.
	Must be vigilant, responsible, disciplined, and physically fit.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to follow security procedures and maintain a professional standard of conduct.
	Preferred candidates: Applicants who reside in Lekki and its environs.


Salary
N110,000 net monthly (shifting basis).

Application Closing Date: 13th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using "Security Officer – Lekki" as the subject of the email.

Note


	For enquiries: 08138477094
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.


 

2.) Head Chef

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	The successful candidate will lead the kitchen team and oversee the preparation and presentation of a diverse intercontinental menu.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead and manage the kitchen team and daily kitchen operations.
	Minimum of 5 to 8 years as a chef with atleast 2 years in supervisory role
	Develop, execute, and maintain high-quality intercontinental menus.
	Demonstrate strong practical knowledge of dishes such as Beef Tenderloin/Steak, Grilled or Seared Salmon, Lobster Thermidor, Seafood Risotto, Chicken Cordon Bleu, Chicken Piccata, Lasagna, Spaghetti Bolognese, Beef Stroganoff, Paella, Fish & Chips, Caesar Salad, Caprese Salad, and gourmet burgers.e.t.c
	Ensure consistency in taste, quality, portioning, and presentation.
	Manage food costing, portion control, inventory, and kitchen supplies.
	Train and supervise kitchen staff.
	Maintain strict food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
	Create menus and specials while maintaining variety and quality.
	Minimise food wastage and control kitchen costs.
	Work effectively in a professional and fast-paced kitchen environment.


Education Requirements


	Minimum of an HND / Bachelor’s Degree in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, Catering, Food Production, or a related field.
	Professional culinary qualifications or recognised chef certifications will be an added advantage.


Benefits


	Salary: N300,000 – N350,000 net monthly
	Accommodation: Provided


Application Closing Date: 9th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using “Head Chef – Lekki” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

3.) Sous Chef

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	The ideal candidate must have practical experience preparing a variety of intercontinental dishes and be able to support the Head Chef in maintaining high kitchen standards.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare and present a wide variety of intercontinental dishes to a high standard.
	Experience preparing Intercontinental dishes such as Chicken Alfredo, Lasagna, Spaghetti Bolognese, Chicken Cordon Bleu, Beef Steak with Pepper Sauce, Seafood Pasta, Grilled Chicken, Fish & Chips, Risotto, Caesar Salad, and gourmet burgers. e.t.c
	Assist the Head Chef with daily kitchen operations and food production.
	Supervise kitchen staff and ensure recipes and portion sizes are followed.
	Maintain high standards of food quality, presentation, hygiene, and sanitation.
	Assist with stock management and minimise food wastage.
	Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a busy kitchen environment.
	Good teamwork, communication, and organisational skills.


Requirements


	Minimum of an OND / HND / Bachelor’s Degree in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, Catering, Food Production, or a related field.
	Professional culinary training or relevant certifications will be an added advantage.


Benefits


	Salary: N200,000 net monthly
	Accommodation: Provided.


Application Closing Date: 10th October, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using “Sous Chef – Lekki”" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
